description: Price a whole plant list or planting schedule from wholesale growers' live stock lists: each line matched to a grower, size and trade price, with the growers near the job preferred. Returns the priced lines and a link to the priced list on HortOS, which the person opens, checks and sends themselves. This tool does not place an order.

job.description: Optional: a name for the job or site.

list.description: The plant list as text, one plant per line with quantity, name and pot size, e.g. '40 x Lomandra Tanika 140mm'.

near.description: Optional: the job's suburb, town or postcode, so growers near the job are used.

name: price_plant_list
title: Price a plant list
